lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn4Pb4O12 (reduced formula ZnPbO3) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Pb centers as octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, while Zn centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement of twelve O neighbors; O centers are coordinated by two Pb neighbors. The neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Pb octahedra and face-sharing between Pb octahedra and Zn 12-vertex polyhedra.
